newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Experience says dividend a prospect.
newsitem.headline: NZ Experience says dividend a prospect.

text.p: New Zealand Experience said on Tuesday that continued growth at Rainbow's End, the full year effects of the restructuring of the Christchurch Gondola and the impact of lower interest rate costs through reduced debt levels and falling interest rates, should contribute to improved profitability and increased cashflow.
"This raises the prospects for a dividend in future years," it said.
New Zealand Experience reported a $22,000 profit for the six months to December 31 against an $8.81 million loss in the previous comparable six-month period.
"The profit for the half year, while modest, is immensely satisfying following a long period of restructuring for the company's operations," the company said.
Despite one of the poorest summers in recent history and continued strengthening of the NZ dollar, both Rainbow's End and Christchurch Gondola achieved budgeted revenue and patronage.
"The half year result bodes well for the prospect of achieving a reasonable full year profit assuming average trading conditions for the balance of the year."
It said that to date, no acquisition prospects had satisfied the company's quality criteria.
